title: Lynchburg, VA — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Lynchburg, VA: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Lynchburg is a city in VA with a population of 82,000. Hill City with Liberty University, the James River, and historic architecture. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.4.
